mapper.sql: SELECT p.id, p.triage_guidance, p.selection_guidance, p.note, u.display_name, p.created_at, p.trial_fingerprint, p.trial_passed, p.trial_report, p.tested_at FROM agent_prompt_revision p JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = p.created_by
mapper.select: SELECT s.revision, s.active_revision_id, s.activated_at, p.triage_guidance, p.selection_guidance FROM agent_prompt_settings s LEFT JOIN agent_prompt_revision p ON s.active_revision_id = p.id WHERE s.id = 1
